rules.name: War of Japanese Aggression
rules.description:
China was a divided country without strong political ties to western allies. Ammunition and weapon shortages combined with untrained conscripts and brutal conditions made victory extremely difficult. China was almost always on the defensive.

Before any game, a Chinese battlegroup can always choose to be the Defender in an Attack/Defense scenario rather than be the Attacker or play a Meeting Engagement scenario. The choice is up to the Chinese player. This rule overrides the Horu rule for the Japanese.

selectionEntries.name: Dare to Die Platoon Command Squad

profiles.name: Dare to Die Platoon Command Squad

rules.name: Dire Consequences
rules.description: This battlegroup is fighting a major battle that must not be lost. The dire state of the war means that the troops are desperate to avoid devastating consequences at the hands of the Japanese. At the start of the game, roll 2 D6 and add the result to the battlegroup’s total BR.

rules.name: Scent of Blood
rules.description: Chinese forces are at a turning point in the war. A long string of defeats has been broken, and the mortality of the enemy is on display. Morale is very high following a recent victory. At the start of the game, roll a D6 and add the result to the Battlegroup’s total BR.

rules.name: Polikarpov I-16 Fighter Armaments
rules.description:
Base
----   2x MGs
----   2x 20mm Autocannons

Roll
1    No bombs
2-6 2x small bombs

rules.name: Tupolev ANT-40 Bomber Armaments
rules.description:
Base
----   4x MGs

Roll
1-2  No bombs
3-5  6x medium bombs
6     6x small bombs and 2x large bombs

rules.name: Aircraft Table
rules.description:
1-3 Polikarpov I-16 Fighter
4-5 Tupolev ANT-40 Bomber
6    Player's Choice of Aircraft (Still roll for Armaments)

You may always choose an aircraft from lower on the table than your roll. You must still roll for armament.

rules.name: Captured Vehicle
rules.description: A single captured enemy tank can be included as a Specialist Unit. It must be taken from the Tank Section of the Army List you will be fighting against. This tank cannot be rated as Restricted or Unique in that list. The captured vehicle cannot be resupplied during the game.
